# proxmox_node_disk_smart (Data Source)

Reads S.M.A.R.T. data of one node disk from `/nodes/{node}/disks/smart`. `attributes` maps attribute ids to their JSON representation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_disk_smart" "disk" {
  node = "pve-1"
  disk = "/dev/disk/by-id/ata-..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk` (String) Block device such as `/dev/disk/by-id/...`.
- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (Map of String)
- `health` (String)
- `text` (String)
- `type` (String)
